title: Eight H’s
bestSource: Eight nodes have at most 12 neighbouring pairs, and only as a 2×2×2 cube; 7 of them are consecutive in the string. Exhaustive search agrees (scripts/hp-optimum.ts).
intro: Eight H’s and no P’s. The best fold has 3 contacts on the square lattice and 5 here.
hint: Go around a square, step forward, and go around the square in front of it.
